headline:
MIDDLE EAST TRAVEL WARNING
AMERICANS PREPARE TO LEAVE
FLIGHTS MAY FACE DISRUPTIONS
caption:
The U.S. State Department has urged Americans in the Middle East to exercise heightened caution amid possible flight cancellations, temporary airspace closures and other travel disruptions.

Its worldwide caution notice says Americans already in the region should consider departing — or be prepared to depart — if the security situation escalates. Those outside the Middle East have been advised to seriously reconsider travel to or through the region.

Travellers should monitor official country-specific advisories and check directly with airlines and airports before making plans. Conditions and flight operations can change quickly.
